subject.title: fix(codex): apply retire TTL to stable session-key binding tombstones

question: Should this PR include a plugin-owned Doctor repair for existing permanent retired stable-key rows before it is allowed to close the linked bug report?
rationale: The proposed runtime change prevents new bad rows but does not recover persisted rows that already cause the reported session-continuity failure; choosing an upgrade repair is a merge-critical state-migration decision.

options.title: Add Doctor repair and upgrade proof
options.body: Repair eligible legacy retired stable-key rows through the Codex plugin’s Doctor path and prove an upgraded installation can rebind without manual SQL.

options.title: Land as future-only prevention
options.body: Accept that existing affected users must follow separately documented manual cleanup and remove the closing claim from this PR.

options.title: Pause for migration design
options.body: Hold the PR until the owner chooses safe eligibility rules for identifying and repairing historical tombstones.
